dev.readyCheck: GET /healthz responds; if src/app/main.py does not exist yet, say so rather than creating it

gates.name: mypy
gates.caveat: mypy checks only the paths in pyproject.toml's `files`, and skips dot-directories during its own discovery. A new top-level directory is silently unchecked while this stays green — add it to `files` in the same change that creates it.

gates.name: pytest
gates.caveat: `addopts` excludes the integration marker, so the default run proves nothing about anything DB-backed.

gates.name: pytest -m integration
gates.when: the change touches a repository, a migration, or anything reaching Postgres or pgvector
gates.caveat: needs Docker and the app extra. Without them it errors rather than passing, but it is also excluded from the default run — so a change with no integration coverage looks identical to one with it.
